verdict.rationale: The pack contains no documented public API for Superhuman Mail: no developer docs or SDK appear, and the probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec and no llms.txt (all 404). The only programmatic route is the official Mail MCP server, which lets AI assistants like Claude or ChatGPT drive the inbox. That is a separate MCP story and does not count as a documented public API here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can now drive Superhuman Mail from Claude, ChatGPT, and your favorite AI tools.
